name: show-it-works-ui
description: Every finished coding task ends with a screen recording of the real run and a share link. AI agents publish proof-of-work videos over MCP; you verify results at your own pace — later, from your phone, anywhere — while your other agent sessions keep moving.

api_key.title: Show It Works API key
api_key.description: Create a key at https://showitworks.app/settings and paste it here. It is displayed only once, and it decides which project the recordings land in.
